description: TOR, 2005 June regular phase: 49 of 49 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 49 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 49 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20250121155945: 49 listed, 49 matched to MLB's picks by name (3 by surname in the same round: #296 MLB "Joshua Sowers" / "Josh Sowers"; #596 MLB "Zachary Kalter" / "Zach Kalter"; #896 MLB "Trenton Luyster" / "Trent Luyster")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
